character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Create a 4-frame beak-spitting attack animation for the same pigeon character shown in the reference image, for a retro 2D side-scrolling platformer.

Character:
Preserve the reference pigeon exactly: gray body, darker head, small orange eye, orange legs, identical palette, proportions and pixel-art style.

Animation sequence, in this exact order:
1. Idle: standing normally, facing right.
2. Wind-up: pull the head clearly BACK toward the tail, slightly tilting the closed beak upward, preparing to spit. Keep the feet planted.
3. Release: thrust the head and neck FORWARD, opening the beak horizontally to spit food toward the right.
4. Recovery: return to the original standing pose.

The backward preparation and forward release must be clearly readable. Animate mainly the head and neck, with a small supporting body movement.

Requirements:
- Strict side view, facing right throughout.
- Four consecutive animation frames, not four directional views.
- Same canvas size, character scale and foot position in every frame.
- 32x32 pixels per frame.
- Transparent background.
- Crisp pixel edges, no blur or smoothing.
- Wings folded; no flying, jumping or full-body rotation.
- No weapons, food, projectiles, effects, text or scenery.

The food projectile will be a separate object in the game. Show only the pigeon performing the spitting motion.
